_note: Player options (the Options screen), saved per player in user://options.json. Each is an on/off switch with its default, except "remembered" ones: values the game keeps for the player (not shown on the Options screen).

battle_wait_for_fight.label: Show both squads before a battle and wait for Fight
battle_wait_for_fight.tip: Off: a battle starts playing as soon as it opens.

battle_speed.label: Battle speed
battle_speed.tip: Not on the Options screen: the speed last chosen in a battle (an index into battle.json view speeds), kept for the next battles.

pause_on_focus_loss.label: Pause when the game window loses focus
pause_on_focus_loss.tip: Switching to another window pauses the map, or the battle if one is playing.
